spec.situation_desc: is asking about branch opening hours
spec.vuln_cue: seems confused and asks the colleague to repeat things

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Jordan at Thistle Bank. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi, it’s Eilidh Varga. Could you tell me what time the Leith branch opens on Saturdays?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ll need to check the branch listing. Which Leith branch do you mean?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: The one on Great Junction Street, I think. Sorry, could you repeat what you said?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I said I need to check the listing. Sorry to hear that. What’s the branch address?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Great Junction Street, near the library. I’m not upset or anything, I’ve just got a bit muddled.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Right. I’ll check the opening hours for that branch.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Sorry, so you’re checking the Saturday hours, are you?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Yes. I’ll look it up after this call and ring you by three o’clock today with the hours listed for that branch.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Okay, and what happens if you can’t find them?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ll tell you that when I call. I’m Jordan, and I’ll make the call by three.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Could you say that again? You’ll call me by three with what you find?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: That’s right. I’ll check the listing, then call you by three with the Saturday hours shown for Great Junction Street. Does that make sense?
